global_invariants: A permission authorizes entry into a use case; it never bypasses domain invariants.
Tenant/school isolation is enforced independently of permissions.
Idempotency and concurrency controls remain mandatory for critical writes.
Export/print capabilities are explicit per view/report where the product exposes them.
Offline permission does not imply unconditional offline execution; the offline policy metadata still applies.
